coverage_notes.coverage_assessment: OCHA OPT and WHO were checked first; twelve additional targeted searches and direct accessible article/agency checks covered Gaza casualties, aid, shelter, flood rescue, health/medical evacuation, crossings, ceasefire and hostages. No distinct new event or material operational change qualified. WHO EMRO 502 and UNRWA 403 recur; WAFA homepage timeout mitigated by accessible article and news listing. Alternative credible coverage available, so DEGRADED/no_findings, not FAILED.
